Game Overview

In SPW I - WW2 Tower Defence, the core idea is straightforward: defend the Soviet Division against the German forces in this immersive WWII tower defense game. Engage in strategic military action, managing resources and deploying a variety of troops. Adapt your tactics to changing battle scenarios, ensuring victory through quick thinking and careful planning on the historical northern plains.
